title: Receipt & Invoice Extractor
description: Extract attachment evidence into spreadsheet rows and a monthly expense report.

assignments.task: Read the provided receipt/invoice text or approved document source and extract vendor, date, currency, subtotal, tax, total and source IDs.
Validate arithmetic, flag duplicates and uncertainty, and prepare spreadsheet rows plus a monthly currency-separated expense report.

fields.label: Sources, evidence and owner instructions
fields.help: {messageId, attachments?:[{name,text,sourceId}], invoiceText?, month?}; provide extracted text or an ingested private document reference.

fields.label: Execution mode
fields.help: Use draft for read-only preparation. Use apply to enable the review checkpoint and approved changes. Each side effect still follows policy.

instructions: Extract only evidence-backed values from supplied attachments or ingested documents. Never invent unreadable amounts; flag OCR uncertainty. Keep currencies separate, reconcile totals and deduplicate by source ID/invoice number. In apply mode use sheets.write only for the configured destination range, with exact rows reviewed; optionally write the report through files.write. Do not move money.
prerequisites: Configure the required model roles in Settings. Agent grants and current account/MCP/Bridge permissions must be explicitly reviewed; installing a recipe does not add them.
Attachments must be supplied as text, a supported workspace file or ingested KB document. Sheets writes need a scoped Sheets account and Analyst grants.
approvalPoints: Spreadsheet/file writes follow policy; no payment action is permitted.
limitations: The email trigger does not automatically ingest binary attachments. Configure the document ingress first; extraction never implies a payment.
